title: Closing and Funding Timetable: Document Draw, Package Validity and Package Review
content:
The Closing and Funding timetable gives, for each closing method, the lead time for drawing closing documents, how long a drawn package stays signable, the power of attorney approval lead time, how many signing moves the package tolerates, and how long Larkspur takes to review a signed package before funding.

| Closing method | Draw lead (business days before the scheduled closing date) | Package validity (calendar days after the draw date) | Power of attorney approved by (business days before the scheduled closing date) | Signing moves allowed within validity before a redraw | Signed-package review before funding (business days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Larkspur Traditional Wet Closing | 2 | 5 | 0 (not used) | 1 | 0 |
| Larkspur Escrow Dry-Funding Closing | 2 | 5 | 0 (not used) | 1 | 1 |
| Larkspur Mobile Notary Closing | 2 | 5 | 0 (not used) | 1 | 0 |
| Larkspur Hybrid eClosing | 2 | 5 | 0 (not used) | 1 | 0 |
| Larkspur Remote Online Notarization Closing | 2 | 3 | 0 (not used) | 0 | 0 |
| Larkspur Power of Attorney Closing | 3 | 5 | 5 | 1 | 1 |
| Larkspur Mail-Away Closing | 4 | 10 | 0 (not used) | 0 | 1 |

## What each column means

- **Draw lead**: the number of business days before the scheduled closing date by which documents are drawn.
- **Package validity**: the number of calendar days after the draw date through which the package may be signed.
- **Power of attorney approval**: the number of business days before the scheduled closing date by which the power of attorney must be approved; 0 where the method does not use one.
- **Signing moves before a redraw**: the number of times a signing can be moved within the package's validity before a redraw is needed. A figure of 0 means any move of the signing needs a redraw.
- **Signed-package review**: the business days Larkspur takes to review a signed package before funding a dry or mail-away closing, as the figure stands in the table for each method.

## Illustrations (hypothetical dates)

- A Mail-Away package drawn on a Monday the 3rd has a validity of 10 calendar days, so the last signable day is Thursday the 13th.
- A Remote Online Notarization package drawn on the 3rd has a validity of 3 calendar days, so the last signable day is the 6th; because 0 moves are allowed, moving that signing at all calls for a redraw.
